summary: Timebound minimal session extract with scrub for partner compliance validation
description:
Issue summary:
Request from Partner Compliance (Vendor: Veritas Analytics) for a limited extract of prod inference sessions to validate redaction behavior against their PII-detection tooling. They need a minimal sample (approx. 150 sessions) scoped to the partner's tenant IDs and timeframe.

Impact:
- Partner requires sample within 72 hours for audit window.
- High sensitivity due to potential customer PII in free-form prompts/responses; must enforce strict redaction and two-person control.

Environment:
- prod (us-east-1) serving runtime.
- Session slicing will read from secure eventstore and inference-telemetry index; no full database exports.

Request details / Acceptance criteria:
1) Provide up to 150 anonymized session records that meet the partner-provided filter (tenant IDs and 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-05).
2) Apply canonical redaction script (see linked confluence) to remove or pseudo-anonymize: email addresses, phone numbers, payment tokens, and any 16+ digit numeric sequences.
3) Hash user identifiers (salted HMAC), keep mapping only in ephemeral HSM-wrapped artifact owned by Security; mapping must be destroyed after verification.
4) Ensure stripped payloads contain only: request timestamp, anonymized user_id, model_version, token_count, and the redacted prompt/response.
5) Produce a verification checklist and a diff report showing pre/post redaction counts for common sensitive regexes.
6) Delivery via secure S3 bucket with KMS encryption and two-person ACL (Compliance + Security).
7) Retention: 72 hours from delivery, then automatic deletion with audit log entry.

Steps to reproduce (operational):
- Query telemetry index using partner filter: tenant_id in [TEN-AX89, TEN-B7Z2]; time range 2026-03-01..2026-03-05.
- Stream matching session IDs to staging processing container (scrub-runner-v2).
- Run redaction script: redact_v2.py --rules confluence://workspace/redaction/rules-2026-02 --output scrubbed/.

2026-03-12 | Marcus Lee (SRE): Preparing export. Will attach pre/post redaction counts and upload to secure s3://redwood-partner-exports/INT-112358/ with KMS and ACLs. Scheduled deletion: 2026-03-15 14:00 UTC.
investigation_notes: SRE run 2026-03-11 09:30 - initial scan returned 220 matching sessions. Sampling plan: deterministic hash sampling on session_id to select 150 to avoid bias. Initial run of redact_v2 flagged 12 instances of long numeric strings not matching existing rules; updated regex to capture bank sort codes and one-off telemetry artifacts. Redaction script test run: 150 -> scrubbed 150; pre/post counts: emails 34->0, phones 11->0, 16+ digits 6->0. Script left model tokens and counts intact. No KB cache keys were included in payloads. Security validated KMS usage and ephemeral role creation.
resolution_notes: Export completed 2026-03-12 13:45 UTC. Files uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-exports/INT-112358/ with KMS key and bucket ACLs limiting access to elena.garcia@redwood.com and derrick.huang@redwood.com. Two-person approval recorded in Confluence page. Diff report and scrubbed sample (150) delivered to Veritas via secure transfer. Lifecycle policy ensures deletion 2026-03-15 14:00 UTC; deletion job executed and audit log entry created: audit-id AUD-20260315-7782. Mapping HMAC salt was rotated and the mapping artifact destroyed using KMS Destroy as per procedure. Follow-up: closed-loop attestation requested from Veritas; copy of audit logs added to compliance evidence store.
final_status_note: Delivery confirmed; partner requested minor rule tweak which will be handled via INT-112359 (follow-up). Audit artifacts archived in compliance evidence store.
